You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26731, in your own card thread. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26731` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26731 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6447132861, verbatim: "a new state_machine / format / json_schema validation saves immediately as a live rule on `created_at` with an empty message, and the conditional rule's wording inverts `when`. Hold a new rule as a draft until it is complete, and fix the wording. … Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling on the card.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `f79ec289`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` already holds a NEW guarded rule (`script`, `cross_field`, `conditional`) in the panel until its guard is set (objectui#11820, see `ObjectValidationsPanel.newRuleWaits-11820.test.tsx`), but `makeSkeleton` (≈L367) gives `state_machine` / `format` / `json_schema` `field: firstField` and `message: ''`, and #11820 deliberately writes "a type with no guard … at once". So the likely fix extends that same panel hold to these three types (missing field or message ⇒ held, with the existing held line and hint), rather than a second mechanism. Measure whether `firstField` is the object's first field (the card saw `created_at`).
- An empty transition row is stored as `"": []`: measure where the transitions editor writes it, and drop empty rows at write time.
- The conditional caption: `engine.studio.rules.celPre` ("Fail condition (CEL) — when the condition is …") is shared with `script`; a `conditional`'s `when` needs its own caption ("the inner rule applies when …"), en and zh. Add the new key next to its family in whatever home holds `engine.studio.rules.*` on your base (today the private table `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`; #25922 S4 will move that family later and is serialised behind this card).

### Scope

File surface: `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` + the i18n row(s) for the new caption + tests: per type (state_machine, format, json_schema) a new rule is held until field and message are set and then written once; an empty transition row is not stored; the conditional caption differs from the script one in en and zh. Ablation: drop the hold for the three types ⇒ the new tests go red. Keep `newRuleWaits-11820` and `presets-11861` green (presets-11861 finds the script group by `/Fail condition/`). ⛔ No change to an EXISTING rule's editing or to the type-switch placeholder; ⛔ no spec change.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected (the panel writes the same rule shapes, only later); say otherwise if the diff shows it. No changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`), unless the i18n row lands in a published package.
